newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Kish announces financial restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Kish announces financial restructuring.

text.p: Kish Resources Plc said on Wednesday it had entered into various settlement arrangements with the company's lenders and creditors.

Kish said in a statement that an agreement had been entered into with Waterford Finance & Investment Ltd which has given Kish an unsecured loan of 0.25 million punts for the purpose of settling certain creditors and lenders.
The group said Waterford had no former association with Kish, nor has it held any shares in Kish.

Kish said it has also negotiated a settlement with certain other creditors and lenders, whereby debts totalling 1.64 million punts would be satisfied by the issue of 162,700,000 new ordinary shares at 1p per share. issue of the 162,700,000 new Ordinary Shares, Kish's liabilities, which were about 2.1 million, will reduce to approximately 0.1 million punts, it said.
